doctrine: Provisional (brief section 6.3): a maritime, opportunistic, partially decentralized faction built on raiding, capture, salvage, smuggling, reputation, tribute and control of movement. Proposed strengths: sea movement, coastal attack, rapid exploitation, capture and reuse of equipment, smuggling, raiding supply, flexible alliances, movable wealth. Proposed weaknesses: long formal sieges, deep interior occupation, stable large-scale production, cohesion after major leadership or wealth loss, and repair of specialized captured equipment. Prose only; nothing in the strategy tree may branch on it before S15.
victory_conditions: Provisional (brief section 6.3 proposed victory pressure): control enough ports, routes, movable wealth and tribute that commerce occurs with pirate permission. Not an ordinary-faction victory condition -- brief section 20 leaves those Open.
